faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AN Port Management Board Pilot Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the AN Port Management Board Pilot Officer recruitment is 20th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Pilot Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Pilot Officer post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 2,50,000/- per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum qualification and experience required for the Pilot Officer role?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Pilot Officer position, candidates must possess a Certificate of Competency (CoC) as Master of Home Tradeship granted by the Government of India or an equivalent qualification, along with 05 years of experience as a Master of Home Trade Ship.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Pilot Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Pilot Officer post is 55 years. However, candidates above 55 years may also be considered if they are medically fit and provide a valid medical fitness certificate.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Pilot Officer position?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it carefully, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post or Registered Post before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Pilot Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Pilot Officer recruitment involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their submitted documents and qualifications.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of AN Port Management Board, which is www.andamannicobar.gov.in. The links are also provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job. The AN Port Management Board has released the notification for recruitment on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies for the Pilot Officer post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the post of Pilot Officer in the AN Port Management Board recruitment 2026.
